001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel;
002
003import android.net.Uri;
004import android.util.Log;
005import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
006import androidx.lifecycle.DefaultLifecycleObserver;
007import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
008import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
009import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData;
010import androidx.lifecycle.Transformations;
011import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel;
012import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel;
013import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
014import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Track;
015import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User;
016import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.PinRepository;
017import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.UserRepository;
018import io.reactivex.rxjava3.disposables.CompositeDisposable;
019import java.util.List;
020import java.util.Objects;
021import javax.inject.Inject;
022
023/**
024 * PinViewModel serves as the ViewModel for managing UI-related data for pins and tracks in a
025 * lifecycle-aware manner. It facilitates interaction between the UI and the repositories, primarily
026 * {@code PinRepository} and {@code UserRepository}, to handle operations such as saving, fetching,
027 * and deleting pins and their related data. Additionally, it handles image capture URIs and manages
028 * asynchronous operations with composite disposables.
029 * <p>
030 * This ViewModel is constructed using dependency injection (Hilt) and extends {@code ViewModel},
031 * implementing {@code DefaultLifecycleObserver} to cleanly manage lifecycle-related tasks.
032 */
033@HiltViewModel
034public class PinViewModel extends ViewModel implements DefaultLifecycleObserver {
035
036  private final PinRepository pinRepository;
037  private final UserRepository userRepository;
038  private final MutableLiveData<Long> pinId;
039  private final MutableLiveData<Track> track;
040  private final LiveData<Pin> pin;
041  private final MutableLiveData<User> user;
042  private final MutableLiveData<Uri> captureUri;
043  private final MutableLiveData<Throwable> throwable;
044  private final CompositeDisposable pending;
045
046  private Uri pendingCaptureUri;
047
048  /**
049   * Constructs a new instance of the {@code PinViewModel} class. This ViewModel acts as a mediator
050   * between the {@code PinRepository} and {@code UserRepository}, managing LiveData and
051   * dependencies to facilitate the interaction between the UI layer and the underlying data
052   * sources. It also handles operations such as pin fetching, saving, and managing related UI
053   * state.
054   *
055   * @param pinRepository  The {@code PinRepository} instance used for performing data operations
056   *                       related to pins and tracks. Must not be null.
057   * @param userRepository The {@code UserRepository} instance used for fetching or managing
058   *                       user-specific data. Must not be null.
059   */
060  @Inject
061  PinViewModel(PinRepository pinRepository, UserRepository userRepository) {
062    this.pinRepository = pinRepository;
063    this.userRepository = userRepository;
064    pinId = new MutableLiveData<>();
065    pin = Transformations.switchMap(pinId, pinRepository::get);
066    track = new MutableLiveData<>();
067    user = new MutableLiveData<>();
068    captureUri = new MutableLiveData<>();
069    throwable = new MutableLiveData<>();
070    pending = new CompositeDisposable();
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Saves a given {@code Pin} to the database by associating it with the current user and the track
075   * currently being processed. This method resets the throwable state before performing the save
076   * operation and handles completion, errors, and pending states.
077   *
078   * @param pin The {@code Pin} object to be saved. It must contain valid data and will be updated
079   *            internally with the ID of the current user and the associated track.
080   */
081  public void savePin(Pin pin) {
082    // 2/12/25 Reset our throwable LiveData.
083    throwable.setValue(null); // Will be invoked from controller on UI thread.
084    userRepository
085        .getCurrentUser()
086        .map((user) -> {
087          this.user.postValue(user);
088          pin.setUserId(user.getId());
089          //noinspection DataFlowIssue
090          pin.setTrackId(track.getValue().getId());
091          return pin;
092        })
093        .flatMap(pinRepository::save)
094        .ignoreElement()
095        .subscribe(
096            () -> {
097            },
098            this::postThrowable,
099            pending
100        );
101  }
102
103  /**
104   * Initiates the process of fetching a Pin identified by the specified pin ID. This method resets
105   * the throwable state to null before setting the given pin ID, which triggers the relevant
106   * data-fetching and LiveData state updates.
107   *
108   * @param pinId The unique identifier of the Pin to be fetched. Must be a non-negative long value.
109   */
110  public void fetch(long pinId) {
111    throwable.setValue(null);
112    // TODO: 2/18/25 Consider this.pin.setValue(null)
113    this.pinId.setValue(pinId);
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Deletes the specified {@code Pin} entity from the repository. This method clears the current
118   * throwable state, performs a removal operation on the repository, and manages completion,
119   * error handling, and pending states through reactive streams.
120   *
121   * @param pin The {@code Pin} object to be deleted. It must be a valid, existing entity
122   *            in the repository.
123   */
124  public void delete(Pin pin) {
125    throwable.setValue(null);
126    pinRepository
127        .remove(pin)
128        .subscribe(
129            () -> {
130            },
131            this::postThrowable,
132            pending
133        );
134  }
135
136  /**
137   * Confirms the capture operation by updating the capture URI state based on the operation's success
138   * and resetting pending state. If successful, the pending capture URI is assigned to the capture
139   * URI; otherwise, the capture URI is cleared.
140   *
141   * @param success Indicates whether the capture operation was successful. If true, the capture URI
142   *                is updated to the pending capture URI. If false, the capture URI is set to null.
143   */
144  public void confirmCapture(boolean success) {
145    captureUri.setValue(success ? pendingCaptureUri : null);
146    pendingCaptureUri = null;
147  }
148
149  /**
150   * Clears the current capture URI by setting its value to null. This method is typically used
151   * to reset or remove any information about the URI associated with a capture operation,
152   * ensuring that subsequent operations do not mistakenly use outdated or irrelevant data.
153   */
154  public void clearCaptureUri() {
155    captureUri.setValue(null);
156  }
157
158  /**
159   * Retrieves a {@code LiveData} object representing the ID of the current pin.
160   *
161   * @return A {@code LiveData<Long>} instance that provides the current pin ID. The value
162   *         may be null if no pin is currently set or available.
163   */
164  public LiveData<Long> getPinId() {
165    return pinId;
166  }
167
168  /**
169   * Retrieves a {@code LiveData} object representing the current {@code Pin} being managed by the ViewModel.
170   *
171   * @return A {@code LiveData<Pin>} instance that provides the current pin. The value may be null if no pin
172   *         is currently set or available in the repository.
173   */
174  public LiveData<Pin> getPin() {
175    return pin;
176  }
177
178  /**
179   * Retrieves a {@code LiveData} object representing the current {@code Track} being managed by the ViewModel.
180   *
181   * @return A {@code LiveData<Track>} instance that provides the current track. The value may be null if
182   *         no track is currently set or available in the repository.
183   */
184  public LiveData<Track> getTrack() {
185    return track;
186  }
187
188  public void setTrack(Track track) {
189    if (!Objects.equals(this.track.getValue(), track)) {
190      this.track.setValue(track);
191    }
192  }
193
194  public LiveData<List<Pin>> getPins() {
195    return Transformations.switchMap(track, pinRepository::getAllForTrack);
196  }
197
198  public LiveData<List<Track>> getTracks() {
199    return pinRepository.getAllTracks();
200  }
201
202  public LiveData<Uri> getCaptureUri() {
203    return captureUri;
204  }
205
206  public void setPendingCaptureUri(Uri pendingCaptureUri) {
207    this.pendingCaptureUri = pendingCaptureUri;
208  }
209
210  public LiveData<Throwable> getThrowable() {
211    return throwable;
212  }
213
214  @Override
215  public void onStop(@NonNull LifecycleOwner owner) {
216    pending.clear();
217    DefaultLifecycleObserver.super.onStop(owner);
218  }
219
220  /**
221   * Fetches the currently authenticated user and updates the associated LiveData asynchronously.
222   * Clears any previously posted throwable state before initiating the operation. Uses the
223   * {@code UserRepository} to retrieve the user entity. If the fetch is successful, the user data
224   * is posted to the LiveData. In case of an error, the throwable state is updated. Handles
225   * pending state to indicate the operation progress.
226   *
227   * This method operates on the following streams:
228   * - Success: Posts the fetched user to the associated LiveData.
229   * - Error: Posts the encountered exception to the throwable state.
230   * - Completion: Updates the pending state to reflect operation completion.
231   */
232  private void fetchCurrentUser() {
233    throwable.setValue(null);
234    userRepository
235        .getCurrentUser()
236        .subscribe(
237            user::postValue,
238            this::postThrowable,
239            pending
240        );
241  }
242
243  /**
244   * Posts the specified {@code Throwable} to the ViewModel's throwable state, making it available
245   * to observe for error handling. This method also logs the throwable message and stack trace for
246   * debugging purposes.
247   *
248   * @param throwable The {@code Throwable} instance representing an error or exception encountered
249   *                  during ViewModel operations. Must not be null.
250   */
251  private void postThrowable(Throwable throwable) {
252    Log.e(edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel.PinViewModel.class.getSimpleName(),
253        throwable.getMessage(), throwable);
254    this.throwable.postValue(throwable);
255  }
256
257}
